name: T3 Code Server
description: Project-independent T3 server with a prepared sandboxed browser and persistent worktrees.

version.description: Exact T3 runtime version, or latest to follow channel. Exact versions remain pinned at startup.

channel.description: T3 release channel, resolved from published releases.

autoUpdate.description: Check for a newer runtime on container startup. Updates restart only T3 and persist without rebuilding the container.

user.description: Existing non-root user; automatic uses the devcontainer remoteUser.

workspace.description: Repository path, or auto for /workspace or a single /workspaces checkout.

autoStart.description: Start the server on every container start.

startupUpdateTimeout.description: Maximum seconds for startup update preparation; activation and rollback finish separately.

installerSha256.description: Optional SHA-256 required when downloading the official installer; empty follows the current official installer.

repairHomeOwnership.description: Explicitly repair UID/GID changes within the selected user home, for an opted-in persistent home mount.
